description.value: This study examined cue-elicited brain activation in African American and Caucasian smokers and non-smokers using block-design fMRI, focusing on smoking versus neutral or baseline images and ethnicity-by-condition interactions.

spans.text: In the current study, we assessed brain activation in response to smoking cues in AA and CC smokers using block-design fMRI.

description.value: 10-item self-report depression scale administered before scanning.

Ten-item questionnaire of smoking urges administered immediately before and after scanning and between runs; responses were rated from 0 to 100 and averaged into craving scores.
